linkedin:
Building a product page is usually the slowest part of testing a new product: photos, copy, offers, FAQ.

We tried Dropmagic: pasted one AliExpress link (a 3D moon lamp), answered 5 quick questions (language, style, shop name, who it's for, why they buy), and it built the full page with bundles and an FAQ.

Useful for:
→ Testing a product idea before investing in design
→ A first draft you then edit, not a final page

Watch out: the AI writes social proof and claims. Check every line before you publish.

Free plan builds and previews. Publishing to Shopify needs Pro at $79/mo. Full review in the first comment.
